name: 04-diverse-round-table
prompt: Wide shot of a small round dinner table of ten senior executives of mixed ages, genders and ethnicities, leaning in, deep in conversation, no laptops, no lanyards, crystal glasses, warm low light, soft pink and gold neon glow on dark walls behind. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
